propositions: unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries based on forward entry jira_key presence, leaving orphaned reverse bindings when forward entries lack jira_key or are removed out-of-band
Orphaned reverse keys reported by bridge fsck as reverse_missing_forward integrity faults cannot be cleaned up through the public API, requiring manual _data access
unbind() is incidentally safe only by whole-file invariant that jira_key existence always implies reverse entry existence, not by its own logic
Concurrent merge-ours resolution of bindings.json can drop forward entries wholesale without triggering reverse cleanup, permanently leaking reverse keys
unbind() must unconditionally remove both forward entry and any residual reverse entries pointing to local_id via a sweep after the keyed pop
bridge fsck --repair verb with four pre-write guards can safely prune orphaned reverse_missing_forward entries via the public BindingStore API
